description: Synthetic NEI transcripts (fictional bands): a contradictory chain – one question answered by two bands (branch), an announcement that names a different asker than the question read out (contradiction), a paraphrased question that fits two near-identical questions of the same band in two files (ambiguous), and a clip of another band inside an answer (mixed speakers).

lines: 0.00-2.40 S2: Hi, we're Salt Cathedral.
2.40-8.00 S2: Our question for the next band is: if you could only bring one item on tour, what would it be?
0.00-2.00 S2: We are Night Ferry.
2.00-6.80 S1: This question comes from Salt Cathedral: if you could only bring one item on tour, what would it be?
6.80-13.00 S2: My pillow. Without my pillow I am a monster.
13.00-15.50 S3: Hi, this is Pale Rider, we just walked in, sorry!
15.50-18.00 S1: Now you get to ask a question for the next band.
18.00-23.40 S2: My question for the next band is: what is the craziest thing you have ever seen in the audience?
0.00-2.10 S2: Hello, we are Static Orchard.
2.10-7.00 S1: The question is from Salt Cathedral. If you could only bring one item on tour, what would it be?
7.00-12.50 S2: A kettle. Proper tea, every day, everywhere.
12.50-15.00 S1: Now you can ask a question for the next band.
15.00-20.00 S2: My question for the next band is: when were you last scared to go on stage?
0.00-2.20 S2: We're Velour Engine.
2.20-7.10 S1: This question comes from Night Ferry: what is the craziest thing you have ever seen in the audience?
7.10-15.00 S2: A guy proposing to his girlfriend during our loudest song. She said yes, I think.
15.00-17.30 S1: Now you get to ask a question for the next band.
17.30-22.00 S2: My question for the next band is: what was the worst show you have ever played?
0.00-2.00 S2: This is Velour Engine again.
2.00-6.50 S2: I want to know: what was the worst gig you have ever played?
0.00-2.00 S2: Hi, we are Ember Choir.
2.00-7.20 S1: This question comes from Static Orchard: what is the craziest thing you have ever seen in the audience?
7.20-13.00 S2: Someone crowd-surfing in a rubber boat. Twice.
13.00-15.20 S1: Now you get to ask a question for the next band.
15.20-20.00 S2: My question for the next band is: which band would you love to tour with?
0.00-2.00 S2: This is Granite Bloom.
2.00-6.20 S1: Velour Engine wants to know: what was your worst show or gig?
6.20-14.00 S2: Ten people, a broken PA, and the bar closed before we started.
14.00-16.00 S1: Now you get to ask a question for the next band.
16.00-20.00 S2: My question for the next band is: what do you do the minute you get off stage?
